statements.t: Our proven operating model has delivered regular double-digit growth and meaningful margin expansion since 2021, and I expect will continue to drive strong performance in 2027 and 2028.
The Company is updating its full-year 2026 outlook as a result of the strong year-to-date performance and near-term market opportunities.

“As we work to conclude another banner year at CECO, we expect to deliver results at or above the full year guidance we have raised multiple times throughout the year, including the most recent increase in August.
The projects in our backlog remain largely on schedule, and our sales pipeline continues to expand in both size and quantity.

While we anticipate additional orders to be realized in power markets, I would emphasize that demand for our environmental, industrial and thermal solutions remain equally robust and often are realized later in the project supply chain cycle and generally represent funded, active projects rather than speculative demand,” added Gleason.

The Company introduces its 2027 full year outlook with revenue expected to be between $2.1 billion and $2.3 billion, representing growth of more than 60 percent at the midpoint compared with the midpoint of the Company’s 2026 revenue outlook, and Adjusted EBITDA between $475 million and $525 million, representing growth of more than 130 percent at the midpoint compared with the midpoint of the Company’s 2026…
The Company expects full year free cash flow of between 50 percent and 60 percent of Adjusted EBITDA.
Our full year 2027 outlook highlights further growth and scale.

Since introducing our annual guidance process back in Q3 2021, we have a solid track record of meeting or exceeding our outlook as we incorporate significant backlog and pipeline insights, conservative assumptions on inflation and key market dynamics.

The combination of our proven process and consistent track record, along with our visibility into our backlog and sales pipeline, gives us high confidence that 2027 will be another rewarding year for all our stakeholders.”
A replay of the conference call will be available on the Company’s website for a period of one year.

The GAAP measures are not accessible on a forward-looking basis because we are currently unable to predict with a reasonable degree of certainty the type and extent of certain items that would be expected to impact GAAP measures for these periods but would not impact the non-GAAP measures.
